name: @superatom/connectors
description: Connectors — one kind, the engine connector: each a folder (bridges/<id>/: manifest, bridge.mjs, its own driver), run on the engine one process per connection. API connectors are made on src/api.ts. `pnpm build` checks every connector and writes dist/ (engine.json: the catalogue with each build's hash; bridges.json: the code) for the platform to ship.
